items.description:
I started in development with WordPress and, on my own initiative, introduced modern technologies such as React and React Native, culminating in the creation of a mobile application essential to the company.

- Co-led the end-to-end development of an application in **React Native** for **Sabesp**, focused on managing leak inspections across the city.
- The application enabled field technicians to perform inspections and report data digitally, replacing a previously manual workflow.
- Developed the application using **React Native, TypeScript, and Styled-Components**, ensuring robust and maintainable code.
- Designed and implemented user interfaces, translating **Figma** prototypes into responsive front-end components with **Next.js**.
- Developed an administrative panel for system management and maintained client websites using **WordPress** and **Elementor PRO**.

items.title: Junior Front End Developer

image.name: you_develop.jpg
image.alt: Yellow text 'YOU' inside a white circle with a colorful gradient border.
image.caption: The word 'YOU' in bright yellow is centrally placed within a crisp white circle, framed by a vibrant gradient border.

items.description:
In a dynamic software factory environment, I quickly evolved from fundamental tasks to developing and contributing to complex web applications for a diverse portfolio of clients.

- **Developed from scratch** a complete coupon raffle platform with **Next.js**, using **Firebase** for real-time data management and winner selection.
- Contributed to the development of a travel platform with **Next.js and TypeScript**, implementing authentication with **NextAuth** and file storage with **Amazon S3**.
- Actively participated in building a customer feedback platform with **Remix.js and MongoDB**, assisting in the integration of Google APIs for data collection and analysis.
- Developed front-end features for various systems, including a restaurant management application and a portfolio platform for designers.
- Participated in an **international project for Germany**, building a delivery platform using Next.js and Firebase.
- Started at the company building and maintaining landing pages, establishing a solid foundation in front-end development best practices.

items.title: Full Stack Developer

image.name: origin9.jpg
image.alt: Blue abstract symbol resembling two inward-pointing arrows forming a diamond shape.
image.caption: This blue abstract symbol features two curved, arrow-like shapes pointing inwards, creating a central diamond that suggests connection or focus.

items.description:
As a full-stack developer, I contributed throughout the lifecycle of complex, large-scale platforms, from database and API to front-end implementation and testing.

- Actively participated in the development of a complete school management platform, contributing to both front-end and back-end.
  - **Back-end:** Created and maintained RESTful API endpoints with **Node.js, Sequelize (ORM), and PostgreSQL** to manage students, classes, enrollments, and teachers.
  - **Front-end:** Developed interactive and responsive user interfaces using **React.js and TypeScript**.
- Implemented **AI to assist teachers in generating lesson plans**.
- Ensured application quality and reliability by writing end-to-end (E2E) tests with **Cypress** and unit tests with **Jest**.
- Optimized database queries to improve performance.
- Collaborated on an inspection project with synchronized web and mobile applications, working on the **React Native** app to implement **off-line first** functionality and data synchronization with the web platform.

items.title: Full Stack Developer
items.description:
Recruited as a full-stack developer and later promoted to a **mid-level** role, contributing to high-stakes, large-scale e-commerce solutions for market-leading companies.

- **Full-Stack Developer (Omnichannel Platform):**
  - Initially maintained and evolved a B2B omnichannel platform, providing an "infinite shelf" solution for enterprise clients.
  - Developed back-end services with **NestJS** to support both the administrative content and product management panel and the customer-facing catalog.
  - Stack: **TypeScript, Nest.js, Docker, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and Next.js**.
- **Mid-Level Developer (VTEX Marketplace):**
  - Recognized for performance, transitioned to a new team to work on the development of the official Correios marketplace, **Mais Correios**.
  - Leveraging the **VTEX** ecosystem, developing and maintaining full-stack solutions, from custom back-end services to front-end components, ensuring high performance and scalability for a nationwide platform.

items.title: Technician in Mechatronics
items.description: A comprehensive program integrating mechanics, electronics, and computer science. This course provided a strong foundation in logical thinking and systems integration, culminating in the design and construction of a functional sheet metal bending machine. This project involved applying principles of mechanics, welding, and material strength analysis, honing the problem-solving skills I now use in software development.

items.title: Systems Analysis and Development
items.description: A higher education program focused on software engineering principles and market-ready skills. The curriculum emphasized hands-on learning through multiple team-based projects, where I applied theoretical knowledge to build full-stack web applications. This project-driven approach was essential for developing both my technical abilities in web development and my interpersonal skills in communication and teamwork, providing the foundational knowledge for my career as a software developer.

items.title: Postgraduate Degree in Software Engineering
items.description: A specialization focused on deepening my expertise in both the technical and managerial aspects of software development. The curriculum covered advanced topics including software architecture (front-end and back-end), agile methodologies, automated testing, and project management, providing strategic skills for designing, leading, and maintaining high-quality, scalable software systems.
